source: Long Island Rail Road current locomotive roster (rail.pgengler.net, accessed 2026-11-15); LIRR rolling stock fleet notes (Newikis, accessed 2026-11-15); Trains Are Fun LIRR diesel roster and motive-power notes
scopeNote: Diesel locomotives only; EMU cars (M3, M7, M9) are intentionally excluded. Passenger road power, yard/work locomotives, and LIRR-owned units leased out are included as roster entries. Historical number blocks can include units that are retired, out of service, or leased to New York & Atlantic Railway; check individual status before treating a unit as active.
